nameEn: Manufacture of lifting and handling equipment
description: This class includes the manufacture of lifting and handling equipment.
includes: manufacture of cranes, mobile lifting frames, straddle carriers, works trucks
manufacture of conveyors and conveyor belts
manufacture of industrial robots for lifting and handling
manufacture of pneumatic and other elevators and conveyors
manufacture of fork-lift trucks and straddle carriers
manufacture of winches, hoists and capstans
manufacture of jacks and pulley tackles
excludes: manufacture of agricultural elevator and conveyor, see 2821
manufacture of loading equipment for aircraft, see 2829
manufacture of continuous mechanical handling equipment for underground use in mines, see 2824
